headline: Earnings per share slip on last quarter, rise on last year
summary_short: EPS was JPY 39.70, down 7.0% from JPY 42.67 in the prior quarter and up 59.6% from JPY 24.88 a year earlier.
summary_long: Only the per-share earnings figure is available on the shard. It fell 7.0% q/q and rose 59.6% y/y. Searches showed first-quarter operating profit up 111% and a raised full-year forecast of JPY 140B sales and JPY 15.6B operating profit, but no third-quarter figures. No drivers are assessed.
